description: This file defines the 'Category' entity class for an e-commerce application, mapping to the 'CATEGORY' database table. It contains fields for category attributes, relationships to descriptions, parent/child categories, and merchant store, along with relevant annotations for persistence and validation.

classes.name: Category
classes.description: Entity class representing a product category with hierarchical structure, descriptions, and metadata for use in an e-commerce platform.

methods.name: getCode
methods.description: Returns the category code.

methods.name: setCode
methods.description: Sets the category code.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Gets the unique identifier of the category.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the category.

methods.name: getAuditSection
methods.description: Retrieves the audit information.

methods.name: setAuditSection
methods.description: Sets the audit information.

methods.name: getDescriptions
methods.description: Returns the list of category descriptions.

methods.name: setDescriptions
methods.description: Sets the list of category descriptions.

methods.name: getCategoryImage
methods.description: Gets the image associated with the category.

methods.name: setCategoryImage
methods.description: Sets the image associated with the category.

methods.name: getSortOrder
methods.description: Returns the sort order of the category.

methods.name: setSortOrder
methods.description: Sets the sort order of the category.

methods.name: isCategoryStatus
methods.description: Checks if the category is active.

methods.name: setCategoryStatus
methods.description: Sets the category's active status.

methods.name: isVisible
methods.description: Checks if the category is visible.

methods.name: setVisible
methods.description: Sets the visibility of the category.

methods.name: getDepth
methods.description: Returns the depth level of the category in hierarchy.

methods.name: setDepth
methods.description: Sets the depth level of the category.

methods.name: getLineage
methods.description: Returns the lineage string representing hierarchical path.

methods.name: setLineage
methods.description: Sets the lineage string.

methods.name: getParent
methods.description: Provides the parent category.

methods.name: setParent
methods.description: Sets the parent category.

methods.name: getMerchantStore
methods.description: Returns the merchant store associated with this category.

methods.name: setMerchantStore
methods.description: Associates a merchant store with this category.

methods.name: getCategories
methods.description: Returns child categories.

methods.name: setCategories
methods.description: Sets the list of child categories.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Returns the primary description from the descriptions list.
